title: Classical soft theorems meet the post-Newtonian expansion
summary: Classical soft theorems govern the non-analytic structure of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation in the low-frequency regime, with the gravitational memory effect providing the canonical realization of the classical soft graviton theorem. While the soft behavior of radiation from hyperbolic scattering is well understood, its realization in gravitationally bound systems remains less explored.
